rules: Every arm-artifact pair must have one exact v1 request and REQUIRED_UNSUPPORTED output accepted by primary and independent base-contract verifiers.
Every output has empty tool and invocation receipts, false correctness and alias claims, zero numerical error, empty unchanged unretained state, and no validation outcome mounted.
The candidate-library sealed digest identifies the authenticated arm-specific unsupported evidence, not a usable candidate library.
Exactly one complete matrix-audit process receipt is canonicalized, referenced 92 times, and charged once.
The receipt's complete user-plus-system CPU is allocated deterministically across exactly one leading artifact per arm; aggregate ledger CPU equals receipt CPU exactly.
All bindings repeat only the exact common-contract resource projection and share one protocol hash.
The Cartesian product of four arms and 23 artifacts must be exact; missing, duplicate, or substituted pairs fail closed.
Completing unsupported resource accounting may close P3 but cannot change conformance, production integration, numerical correctness, or prospective authorization.
Both batch verifiers must reject changed receipt identity/body, pair identity, evidence reason/hash, status, state, resources, CPU allocation, integration, validation, prospective, or unknown fields.
